actions.action: Check soil moisture a few inches down
If bone dry, water thoroughly until it drains
Slide plant out of pot and check roots
If roots are rotten, trim them and repot in fresh well-draining mix
If stem base is mushy, propagate healthy upper stem sections
Make sure pot drains and empty standing water from outer pot
Move plant to bright, indirect light
Cut off yellowing or dead leaves

reason: Underwatering is named only as one of two equal possibilities alongside root rot, but the first step (check soil and water thoroughly if dry) delivers the fix, and the rot checks are safeguarded rather than harmful.
